# Data

## Included (generated by this project)

- `v2_traces/seed*.npz`: SUMO mobility traces. Each file holds positions, speeds, velocities and device classes per
  second.
  - Seeds 100–102: validation.
  - Seeds 42–51: test.
  - Seeds 52–61: fresh 6-h test traces.
- `../results/v2/`: outputs of all runs.
  - Training runs (`cal_hfl`, `test_hfl`, `test_round`), with metrics, resolved configurations and detector weights.
  - Containment experiments.
  - Detector flag profiles (`robust/cache`).
  - Robustness studies (`robust_test`, `r7_*`, `r8_*`, `r9_*`).
  - `r9_flags/`: per-window flow and flag counts of the real-flag replay. No traffic features are included.

## Not included (public third-party datasets)

| Dataset | Source | How to obtain |
|---|---|---|
| 5G-NIDD | Fairdata, https://etsin.fairdata.fi/dataset/9d13ef28-2ca7-44b0-9950-225359afac65 (CC BY 4.0) | `python scripts/fetch_5g_nidd.py` |
| CICIoT2023 | Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity, https://www.unb.ca/cic/datasets/iotdataset-2023.html | Download the CSV files; `python scripts/preprocess.py --dataset ciciot2023 --raw <folder>` |
| CICIDS2017 | Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity, https://www.unb.ca/cic/datasets/ids-2017.html | Download MachineLearningCSV.zip; `python scripts/preprocess.py --dataset cicids2017 --raw <zip>` |

The real-flag replay (`scripts/v2_r9.py prep`) reads the per-session files of 5G-NIDD (`BS1_each_attack_csv.zip`,
`BS2_each_attack_csv.zip`). They are downloaded by `fetch_5g_nidd.py`.
